text: I wanted to write another review! (Only one review per account is allowed 🥹) My tooth started hurting again before I even had my stitches removed, so I quickly made an appointment for a follow-up check. I'd already resigned myself to needing root canal treatment. I also have an upper right molar that every clinic I've been to recommends root canal treatment for. I had an appointment to check the root canal on the day my stitches were removed. I also prepared myself for a while before I could go back to eating. Today, I saw Dr. Kaew again, and she filled my tooth. She said the decay was deep but it could be filled. I was so happy because I thought it wouldn't be possible. For the other tooth that was hurting, she tried drilling into it and said it could be filled. I was overjoyed! This is the first clinic where the doctor actually tried to fill a tooth. I'm so impressed! Thank you to P'Aum, the assistant, too; she was so lovely. The fillings today were so easy. At first, I was worried I wouldn't be able to handle it because of my wisdom tooth extraction wound, but in reality, I completely forgot I'd just had surgery! This is my favorite clinic forever! Also, thank you to the admin for responding so quickly! 😃

text: I went to the dentist because of a sharp, shooting toothache that sent shivers down my spine. It was caused by a cavity I'd been scaling up. My old dentist said I needed root canal treatment, but the appointment was at the end of the month. The next day, the pain returned, and I couldn't wait any longer. I called 4-5 clinics near my place, but all had appointments at the end of the month. Finally, I found this clinic. The person who answered said I had an appointment the next day, so I rushed over. I saw Dr. Supoj. He X-rayed my wisdom tooth (which he didn't find at my old clinic). He explained that root canal treatment with a crown wouldn't last long because the wisdom tooth, which had been pushing against the other tooth, needed to be removed. After removal, my tooth would become loose. He recommended extracting my molar and the wisdom tooth, followed by a dental implant. Dr. Supoj was so kind, like a father figure! I'm usually terrified of dentists, but meeting a doctor who was like a respected elder made all my fear disappear. After that, I scheduled another appointment for the molar extraction and wisdom tooth surgery. I saw Dr. Kaew, who was incredibly kind. She constantly asked if I was okay and talked to me about what she was doing. The atmosphere was very relaxing. The assistants were attentive and even applied Vaseline, as mentioned in previous reviews. It was a very positive experience with both my wisdom tooth extraction and other tooth extractions. Finding a doctor who understands their patient is truly wonderful!

Since I started going to the dentist, I've never met a dentist as skilled, gentle, and kind as Dr. Supoj.

I had severe tooth pain for several days and had been to other clinics, but they couldn't find the cause.

The cost is reasonable, not expensive at all.

The clinic is clean, modern, well-equipped, and very easy to get to as it's right next to the MRT Purple Line (Ministry of Public Health Station).
The staff are all friendly, smiling, and provide excellent service.
